findings.body: The previous advisory remains open. Both views read events.jsonl without the writer guard at src/forge/board.py:203–204. On Windows, an overlapping read can make this replacement raise PermissionError, aborting the enclosing worker, reader, review or test command. Add bounded replacement retries, following src/forge/codex.py:532–539.

findings.body: The previous advisory remains open. A structured missing-session result becomes `error_during_execution` followed by the diagnostic. The worker's prefix check at src/forge/worker.py:443–445 therefore misses it, while the reader checks only stderr at src/forge/story.py:738–740 although the decoded diagnostic is stdout. Both paths refuse instead of starting a fresh session. Recognize the diagnostic in both callers while preserving the error details. The structured response is documented in the [upstream reproduction](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/40609).
findings.title: Preserve missing-session recovery for structured Claude errors
